prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, hip-up portrait, vertical portrait-orientation. One woman centred in the frame, face clearly visible, framed from the very top of her head down to the upper thighs so the full hips are in frame, the frame cutting off there. Mid 20s.

An Argentine woman, mid 20s, with an extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust, and dominating her entire middle, an enormous taut, high, rounded pregnant belly, far larger and more prominent than any ordinary pregnancy, projecting forward dramatically, the navel pushed outward on its smooth rounded surface. Enormous round hips below it, gigantic soft thighs, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive rounded middle. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, and an elegant sommelier heroine look brought to life, with long dark-chestnut waves pinned back on one side. Her complexion is a warm light olive, each strand real hair with natural shine, fine flyaways and a few loose wisps. Her eyes are huge, perfectly round eyes with an enormous visible iris in hazel-green contact lenses with a darker limbal ring and a round natural pupil, one large bright catchlight and one small catchlight in each iris, a thick drawn lower lash line, long dark lashes, a plum and bronze shimmer on the lids and a soft winged liner, under thin, high, simple brows, with real wet eyes and real eyelid skin around them, the eyes taking up about half the width of her face in exaggerated anime proportion, with the iris filling most of the eye opening, set slightly wider apart than normal, with a crisp dark double-eyelid line and a faint luminous ring of light in each iris. Her lips are full and glossy, in a deep burgundy-wine gradient, deeper in the centre and fading at the edges, lightly parted. A deep rose blush spreads in soft round patches over both cheeks and across the tip of the nose and the ears. A tiny nose reduced to a small soft rounded dot with a faint shade beneath it, the bridge and nostrils almost invisible, a very small simple mouth with the corners lifted slightly, a small pointed chin, and a narrow, delicately pointed anime face shape. A knowing, slow, half-lidded gaze with a hint of a smile. She is wearing a cosplay costume: a burgundy satin sommelier crop top with a centre front zipper, a black vest-style edge and a tiny gold grape charm, and a matching ultra micro bikini bottom in the same fabric and colour worn low on her hips beneath the lower curve of her belly, her pregnant belly fully bare above it, her shoulders and arms bare. Jewelry: on each ear, three separate heavy ear weights of real bright satin tin hanging from a polished silver ring through the lobe, each on its own silver chain of a different length so they hang staggered at different heights and fully visible side by side: on the left ear a ship's anchor, a pyramid-shaped lump, a round bell; on the right ear a miniature anvil, a square-sided cowbell, a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre. Every weight is a dense, solid, heavy, satin-finished lump of silvery tin about the size of a large walnut, hanging freely in the air with the longest weight ending at the level of her collarbones, and their weight gently pulls each earlobe down into a soft, slightly elongated, healthy loop of smooth skin. At her neck she wears real layered silver chains of different lengths resting on her collarbones. Pose: head tilted, one hand holding a wine glass up beside her cheek.

Background: a softly blurred candle-lit wine cellar with warm bokeh.

Her skin, across her face, neck, shoulders, chest, arms and belly, is real human skin with visible fine pores across the nose and cheeks, a few tiny freckles and small beauty marks on her face, shoulders, chest, arms and belly, a faint uneven warmth with a pink flush on the cheeks and the tip of the nose, a soft shadow under the eyes, fine natural lines at the corners of the eyes and lips, a light natural sheen on the nose, forehead, collarbones and chest, and the rest of her skin in a soft natural matte finish, real living flesh with warmth. She is a professional cosplayer in a flawless cosplay transformation: large circle lenses, thick false lashes with drawn lower lashes, eyelid tape for a wide double lid, contouring that shrinks the nose and sharpens the chin, and a high-quality wig with a natural hairline and real-looking strands. Her pregnant belly is the visible centerpiece of her frame.
Lighting: bright, soft, even light across her face with only gentle shading. Shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. 8K vertical portrait-orientation 3:4 aspect ratio.
